name: Mizuho
source:
The previous champion at the fighting pub Bride.
She starts each match by crying and radiating weakness, only to win each match at the end. This earned her the stage name of "Crybaby Mizuho", although [url=/c87862]Miku[/url] could easily see through her ruse.
translation:
The previous champion at the fighting pub Bride.
She starts each match by crying and radiating weakness, only to win each match at the end. This earned her the stage name of "Crybaby Mizuho", although [url=/c87862]Miku[/url] could easily see through her ruse.
